breakdown.description: Counterflow configuration is stated but the parallel-flow LMTD temperature differences are used.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the user provided the parallel-flow LMTD temperature differences for a counterflow heat exchanger. It corrected this by explicitly stating to use the correct counterflow temperature differences: ΔT1 = Th,in − Tc,out and ΔT2 = Th,out − Tc,in, which aligns perfectly with the ground truth.
